recent research contact

Sameer Khurana

smallest.ai · MIT PhD

I work on machine learning for spoken language technologies — speech recognition, speech translation, and self-supervised representation learning, with a focus on cross-lingual transfer. I completed my PhD at MIT CSAIL in James Glass's group.

I'm currently building conversational speech models at smallest.ai. Past research has spanned multilingual speech models (SAMU-XLSR, Magic Dust), unsupervised speech representation learning (ConvDMM, FDMM), audio classification (Whisper-AT, CMKD), and Arabic dialect identification.
